# InterviewAI

> A free, native Mac copilot for interviews and meetings (MIT licence). It listens to both sides of a call, transcribes everything on the Mac, and suggests answers grounded in your own files. You run it with your own model: Ollama on the machine, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint with your own key. No account, no licence key, no paywall.

## What it does

- Both sides, live: system audio (them) and your microphone (you) transcribed at the same time, on device. Nothing is recorded.
- Answers while you talk: Auto Answer, plus an action row (What Should I Say, Clarify, Recap, Follow-Up, Answer, Code Hint, Brainstorm) on Cmd+1 to Cmd+7.
- A floating overlay over Zoom, Teams or Meet with the live transcript, the streaming answer and an ask box. Cmd+Shift+H shows or hides it.
- Your phone as a second screen on the same Wi-Fi: the live answer and the action buttons, nothing leaves the local network.
- Grounded in your files: add your resume, the job description and your notes. Pinned files go into every answer.
- Meetings that keep themselves: every finished call is saved with transcript, notes, a summary and a follow-up draft.
- Nine modes plus your own: General, Technical Interview, Looking for Work, Behavioral, Negotiation, Sales, Recruiting, Team Meet, Lecture.
- Calendar, read-only: upcoming meetings on the Live page, one click to start. It never writes to your calendar.

## Quick start

- Download InterviewAI-1.4.0.dmg from the release page, drag the app into Applications, right-click once and choose Open (the app is unsigned).
- Or build from source (macOS 14 or later, Xcode for the Swift toolchain): git clone, then ./build.sh --open
- Tests: swift test
